jcr_content.jcr:title: i-Chips IP00C331 | 4K Quad Input LSI
jcr_content.jcr:description: Upgrade your video applications with i-Chips IP00C331, the 4K Quad Input LSI, delivering unmatched image processing. Contact us today for more information.
jcr_content.keywords: IP00C331, 4K60Hz up/down scaler, advanced features, user-friendly interface, versatile solution, high-quality 4K video processing, input ports, output ports, simultaneous work, independent scaling, composite 4K60Hz output, up/down scaler cores, de-interlacer cores, exceptional video quality, seamless processing, 90-degree rotation, mirror-flip, PQ, HLG HDR support, 3DLUT, color management, compact form factor, high-speed serial interface, comprehensive solution.

textwithimage_1.text:
The IP00C331 is a 4K60Hz up/down scaler that brings a host of impressive capabilities to the table. Designed with a user-friendly interface and advanced features, it is a versatile solution for high-quality 4K video processing.

With its four input ports, each supporting up to 4K60Hz signals, and two output ports of the same impressive resolution, the IP00C331 provides the freedom to work with multiple 4K sources simultaneously. Its ability to independently scale each source to any desired size and position on a composite 4K60Hz output opens up limitless possibilities for creative video manipulation.

text_1.text:
Internally, the IP00C331 boasts eight up/down scaler cores and four de-interlacer cores, ensuring precise scaling and seamless processing of interlaced input. This results in exceptional video quality and smooth transitions when working with various video sources.

In addition to its outstanding scaling capabilities, the IP00C331 offers a range of advanced features that elevate its performance. With 90-degree rotation and mirror-flip capabilities, it allows for versatile video orientation and manipulation, enabling creative expression and customization. The support for PQ and HLG HDR systems (10-bit) and the inclusion of a 3DLUT for color management empower users to create visually stunning content with vibrant colors and impressive dynamic range.

The IP00C331 is not only powerful but also designed with efficiency in mind. Its compact form factor, utilizing the high-speed serial V-by-One® HS bus interface with only eight lanes, minimizes the board space required for integration. This makes it an ideal choice for projects where space is a premium, without compromising on performance.

• The IP00C331 has 4k Single input / 4k Single Output or 4k Dual input / 2k Single output
  • Embedded ARM core (ARM Cortex®-A9)
  • Embedded HDMI2.0b Rx x 2ch
  • DDR input supported (LVCMOS x 2ch)
  • Analog (RGB/COMPONENT & CVBS) input
  • LVDS Tx (148.5MHz x4 FPD-Link) and V-by-One Tx (8 lanes)
  • DDR3 32bit PC1600 (4G/2G/1G bit x16) x 2
  • 3DLUT (17x17x17)
  • HDR (PQ and HLG), Dynamic HDR (SMPTE 2094-10, 40)
  • Warping and edge-blending (Under WQXGA 60Hz output)

Input (4K60Hz 4-port）

  • RGB 30bit / YUV4:4:4 30bit / YUV4:2:0 30bit / YUV4:2:2 20bit / YUV4:2:2 10bit (BT656)
  • @V-by-One® HS 4Gbps, 8 lane 2-port
  • @LV-CMOS 166MHz, supporting dual (EVEN/ODD) and DDR inputs 4-port
  • 4K60Hz input up to 4-port
  • 4K120Hz input supported

Output (4K60Hz 2-port）

  • RGB 30bit / YUV4:4:4 30bit / YUV4:2:2 20bit / YUV4:2:2 10bit (BT656) @V-by-One® HS 4Gbps, 8 lane 2-port
  • 4K60Hz dual output (all the time, fully independent)
  • 4K120Hz output supported

Input & Output

  • Horizontal sync signal 16,384 pixels (max) ＠1ch
  • Horizontal image active area 2,176 pixels (max) ＠1ch

External Memory

  • DDR3-SDRAM 64bit PC1600 (4G/2G/1G x16) x4

External/Internal Sync

  • Output sync is compatible only with internal signal

Independent sync mode is available at each input & output port

Input/Output Sync/Asynchronous Behavior

  • Frame rate conversion
  • Tearing protection
  • External force synchronization
  • Genlock

De-Interlacer

  • Motion adaptive filter based on Y, U, V, YUV 4:2:2
  • All major cadences supported
  • Low latency processing (4-port)

Scaler

  • Zoom/shrink 6-symbol programable FIR filter (10bit/pixel)
  • Embedded ROM (64set)

Noise Reduction

  • 3DNR (H,V,Temporal)
  • MPEG-NR (Mosquito/Block)
  • Chroma error filter

Bit Map OSD

  • 256 colors/High color OSD (64K colors)
  • Embedded font engine (65536 words)
  • Blinking and semi-transparent (4 colors OSD)
  • 90-degree rotation, OSD scroll
  • Serial flash to bitmap

Image Quality Control

  • Color management (full color gamma)
  • 3DLUT (4K60Hz 2-input supported)
  • Uniformity correction (by region and per-pixel)
  • Bias/Gain/Gamma correction
  • H edge enhancement (9symbol), V edge enhancement (5 to 9symbol)
  • Dithering for 10 or 8 bit output

Image Manipulation

  • Mirror/flip/90-degree image
  • Vertical keystone
  • 4-ch overlay, alpha blending, color key blending

CPU Interface

  • 8-bit parallel/4-wire serial

xvYCC/Bt.2020

  • Fully supported

HDR Standard

  • SMPTE ST2084 (PQ) and HLG both methods supported (RGB 10-bit each)

Power Supply

  • 3.3V/1.5V/1.1V

Package

  • 684-pin BGA (0.8mm pitch), 27mm x 27mm
